name: Keplerian Reference Propagator
description: Two-body Keplerian propagator. The reference implementation of the official OrbPro WASM propagator ABI — the minimal complete surface, written to be copied. Also: heliocentric osculating elements for small bodies (asteroids) from SDS $SBD small-body records centred on the Sun (asteroids and comets are never $OMM), with frame snapshots (positions and H-G magnitudes) for hundreds of thousands of rows and one double-precision state for a selected body.

methods.description: Adopts mean elements from SDS $OMM records and replaces the module's element set. Propagation itself is reached through the propagator ABI exports (plugin_propagate / plugin_propagate_batch), not through this invoke surface.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Ratified SDS $OMM mean elements. The module decodes the FlatBuffer itself. A bare (non-$) four-byte identifier is a vendor invention and is deliberately not accepted here, and there is no acceptsAnyFlatbuffer wildcard: a wildcard port is unconformable.
